description: Land Acquisition - Boralasgamuwa and Werahara Kesbewa, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders related to divesting land allotments and correcting land acquisition documentation, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, and survey information. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
